queries_run: DoorDash market share gaining OR losing 2026 Uber Eats
DoorDash new entrant threat food delivery 2026 Amazon Instacart competition

findings.claim: 10-K 列示的競爭對手為 Amazon、Uber Eats、Prosus、Delivery Hero 與在地業者；本地外送業務分散且競爭激烈。
findings.excerpt: Globally, we compete with other local on-demand delivery companies, including Amazon, Uber Eats, Prosus, Delivery Hero, and other local incumbents.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：切換成本低，消費者與商家可多平台並用；競爭壓力已迫使公司調整佣金、費用與促銷，對財務表現造成負面影響。
findings.excerpt: It is relatively easy to switch between offerings in our industry. Consumers have a propensity to shift based on cost, quality, and selection and could use more than one local commerce platform

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：他業公司正開發自動化／無人機配送技術，可能以此與公司競爭，對手可能先於公司規模化。
findings.excerpt: companies operating in different industries are developing and have begun implementing autonomous technologies, and we believe that they may use these technologies to compete with us in the delivery or logistics industries.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋摘要為二手整理，無可逐字複製之原文；份額方向（Q1 2026 稱 DoorDash 於幾乎所有市場增加份額、美國份額約 66-67%、Uber Eats 約 23-25%）與 Instacart 併購（約 $17B）僅列為線索，未核原文。

clues.claim: Q1 2026 財報摘要稱 DoorDash 在幾乎所有市場獲得份額（第三方分析，非公司申報）。
DoorDash 擬以約 170 億美元收購 Instacart，AELP 要求監管機關阻止（掌握近 60% 第三方雜貨外送市場）。
clues.source: Local news: DoorDash is buying Instacart for $17 billion
